questions.question: Akarsh's birthday is on Saturday 29 th July. On what day of the week will be Ojas's Birthday in the same year if Ojas was born on 12 th August?

questions.solution:
Akarsh's birthday → 29 July, Saturday

Ojas’s birthday → 12 August

So, July has remaining → 2 Days

August → 12 Days

Total Days → 14 Days

Dividing 14 days by 7 (as there are 7 days in a week)

We get remainder 0.

Thus, Ojas's birthday will fall on Saturday.

Hence, the answer is Saturday.

questions.question: If 15@7 = 44; 5@4 = 18; 6@17 = 46; then what is the value of 17@4 = ?
questions.questionHtml: If 15@7 = 44; 5@4 = 18; 6@17 = 46; then what is the value of 17@4 = ?
questions.solution:
The pattern is as follows:

(15 + 7) = 22 × 2 = 44

(5 + 4) = 9 × 2 = 18

(6 + 17) = 23 × 2 = 46

So, (17 + 4) = 21 × 2 = 42

Hence, the answer is 42.

questions.question: The impression of an image persists on the retina for about _________ of a second.
questions.questionHtml: The impression of an image persists on the retina for about _________ of a second.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 1/16th.

Key Points

  • This feature is called persistence of vision.
  • Due to this, when many still images are shown in a sequence; they give the illusion of moving images.
  • Persistence of vision is the capacity of the eye to maintain an image on the retina for a moment after the image has disappeared.
  • This is due to a prolonged chemical reaction.
  • As a result, the eye cannot clearly distinguish changes in light that occur faster than this retention period.
  • The changes either go unnoticed or they appear to be one continuous picture to the human observer.
  • If successive images follow quickly enough, these will be perceived as a single continuously moving image.
  • Animation, motion pictures or films, make use of persistence of vision to create the illusion of movement.
  • Films consist of a series of still images (frames) that capture the progress of a subject in motion.

questions.question: Which of the following is an award given by the Government of India to recognize outstanding achievement in National sports?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is an award given by the Government of India to recognize outstanding achievement in National sports?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Arjuna Award.

Key Points

  • Arjuna Award is the second-highest sporting honour in India, the highest being the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award.
  • It is given by the President of India.
  • The selection of candidates is done by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
  • The awards are presented by the President of India in the same ceremony at the Presidential Palace, usually on 29 August.

Additional Information

  • The Ashok Chakra Class-III was renamed the Shaurya Chakra in 1967.
    • The medal was originally established on 4 January 1952 as the "Ashoka Chakra, Class I".
    • As the first step of a three-class sequence of non-combatant bravery decorations.
    • In 1967, these decorations were removed from the "class-based" system and renamed as the Ashoka Chakra, and Shaurya Chakra. 
    • The Ashoka Chakra is India's highest peacetime military decoration awarded for valour, courageous action or self-sacrifice away from the battlefield.
    • Flt. Lt. Suhas Biswas was the first Indian Air Force officer to be awarded the Ashoka Chakra.
    • A recipient can be awarded the Kirti Chakra or Shaurya Chakra in addition for separate acts of gallantry.
  • The Dadasaheb Phalke Awards is India's highest award in cinema.
    • This award is given annually at the National Films Awards.
    • The very first recipient of this award was Devika Rani who received it in 1969 on the occasion of the 17th National Films Awards.
    • Dadasaheb Phalke is known as the 'Father of Indian Cinema'.
    • The first recipient of this award was Devika Rani. 
    • The award comprises of a Swarna Kamal, a Cash Prize of Rs. 10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten Lakhs)certificate, silk scroll and a shawl.
  • About Padma Awards :
    • The Padma Awards are announced annually.
    • It was instituted in 1954, except for brief interruption (suspended) during the years 1978 and 1979 and 1993 to 1997.
    • It is one of the highest civilian honors of India.
    • A higher category of Padma award can be conferred on a person only where a period of at least five years has elapsed since the conferment of the earlier Padma award.
  • Objective:
    • It seeks to recognize achievements in all fields of activities or disciplines where an element of public service is involved.
  • Disciplines:
    • The Awards are given in various disciplines/ fields of activities, viz.- art, social work, public affairs, science and engineering, trade and industry, medicine, literature and education, sports, civil service, etc.

Let work done by Anil in 1 day be y of the total work

⇒ work done by Bimal in 1 day y/2 of the total work

⇒ y = 1/(27/2) = 1/13.5

questions.question: What is the area (in sq. cm) of a circle whose circumference is 22 cm?
questions.questionHtml: What is the area (in sq. cm) of a circle whose circumference is 22 cm?
questions.solution:
Let radius be r

Given circumference = 2πr = 22

⇒ r = 22/2π = 7/2 cm

Area can be given as πr2

⇒ Area = π(3.5)2 = 38.5 cm2

∴ The area of circle is 38.5 cm2

questions.question: If a + b = 10 and ab = 24, then what is the value of a 3 + b 3 ?
questions.questionHtml: If a + b = 10 and ab = 24, then what is the value of a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup>?
questions.solution:
Since we know that (a + b)3 = a3 + b3 + 3ab(a + b), put all the values given values

⇒ 103 = a3 + b3 + 3 × 24(10)

⇒ a3 + b3 = 280

∴ The value of a3 + b3 is 280

questions.question: The 3rd and 6th term of an arithmetic progression are 13 and -5 respectively. What is the 11th term?
questions.questionHtml: The 3rd and 6th term of an arithmetic progression are 13 and -5 respectively. What is the 11th term?
questions.solution:
Let the first term of AP be a and common difference bedFrom the problem’s statement

⇒ 3rd term = a + (3 - 1) d = a + 2d = 13      ----(i)

⇒ 6th term = a + (6 - 1) d = a + 5d = -5      ----(ii)

Now (ii) - (i)

⇒ 3d = -18

⇒ d = - 6, put this in (i)

⇒ a = 13 - (-12) = 25

Now the 11th term can be given as a + 10d

⇒ 11th term = 25 + 10 × (-6) = -35

∴ The 11th term of AP is -35

questions.question: A milkman buys milk at Rs. 25 per litre and adds 1/4 of water to it and sells the mixture at Rs. 26 per litre. His gain (in %) is?
questions.questionHtml: A milkman buys milk at Rs. 25 per litre and adds 1/4 of water to it and sells the mixture at Rs. 26 per litre. His gain (in %) is?
questions.solution:
The milkman mixes 1/4 of 1 litre = 0.25 litre of milk in 1 litre

Cost price of (1 + 0.25 =) 1.25 litres of milk = Rs. 25

Cost price of 1 litre milk = 25/1.25 = Rs. 20

Selling price of 1 litre milk = Rs. 26

∴ Gain % = [(26 - 20)/20] × 100 = 30%

questions.question: In the first 40 overs of a 50 over innings, the run rate was 4.8 runs/over. What is the required run rate in the remaining 10 overs to reach the target of 241 runs?
questions.questionHtml: In the first 40 overs of a 50 over innings, the run rate was 4.8 runs/over. What is the required run rate in the remaining 10 overs to reach the target of 241 runs?
questions.solution:
Total runs scored in 40 overs can be given as

⇒ 40 overs × 4.8 runs/over = 192 runs

⇒ remaining runs can be given as 241 - 192 = 49 runs

⇒ Run rate can be given as 49/10 = 4.9 runs per over

∴ Required run rate is 4.9 runs per over

questions.question: What is the equation of a line of slope 1/3 and y - intercept 5?
questions.questionHtml: What is the equation of a line of slope 1/3 and y - intercept 5?
questions.solution:
Since we know that equation of line of form y = mx + c, where m is slope and c is y intercept of the given line

⇒ y = x/3 + 5

⇒ x - 3y = -15

∴ The equation of line is x - 3y = -15

questions.questionHtml: What will be the total number of tigers left in the six sanctuaries, if 3 tigers are killed by poachers in sanctuary E and 9 tigers are added to sanctuary A?

Initially total number of tigers can be given as

⇒ Total tigers = 29 + 11 + 5 + 10 + 22 + 13 = 90

After the poaching and addition of tigers

⇒ Total tigers remaining = 90 - 3 + 9 = 96

questions.question: If the total tiger population in these six sanctuaries had grown by 20% and 25% in the previous two decades, then what was the total tiger population in these six sanctuaries before 20 years?
questions.questionHtml: If the total tiger population in these six sanctuaries had grown by 20% and 25% in the previous two decades, then what was the total tiger population in these six sanctuaries before 20 years?
questions.solution:
Let the tiger population 20 years before be y

Total tiger population after 20 years = 29 + 11 + 5 + 10 + 22 + 13 = 90

According to the problem statement

⇒ y(1 + 20/100)(1 + 25/100) = 90

⇒ y(1.2)(1.25) = 90

⇒ y = 60

∴ The tigers population 20 years back is 60.

questions.question: The sum of a fraction and 3 times its reciprocal is 19/4. What is the fraction?
questions.questionHtml: The sum of a fraction and 3 times its reciprocal is 19/4. What is the fraction?
questions.solution:
Let the fraction be y

According to the problem statement

⇒ y + 3/y = 19/4

⇒ 4y2 - 19y + 12 = 0

⇒ (y - 4)(y - 3/4) = 0

The required number is 3/4 which satisfies the above given condition

∴ The value of required fraction is ¾.

According to the problem statement

⇒ Amount = p{(1 + 10/100)3}

⇒ 5324 = p(1.331)

⇒ 5324 = 1.331p

⇒ p = 4000

∴ The principle is Rs. 4000

questions.question: Two cyclists P and Q cycle at 20 km/hr and 25 km/hr towards each other. What was the distance (in kms) between them when they started if they met after 56 minutes?
questions.questionHtml: Two cyclists P and Q cycle at 20 km/hr and 25 km/hr towards each other. What was the distance (in kms) between them when they started if they met after 56 minutes?
questions.solution:
Relative speed = 20 + 25 = 45 km/hr

Distance travelled in 56 minutes (56/60 hr = 14/15 hr)

⇒ Distance = 45 × 14/15 = 42 km

∴ The initial distance between them is 42 km

questions.question: ΔABC is right angled at B. If ∠A = 30, what is the length of AB (in cm), if AC = 10 cm?
questions.questionHtml: ΔABC is right angled at B. If ∠A = 30, what is the length of AB (in cm), if AC = 10 cm?
questions.solution:
cos A = AB/AC

⇒ cos 30 = AB/10

⇒ √3 × 10/2 = AB

⇒ AB = 5√3

∴ AB is 5√3 cm

questions.question: ΔABC is right angled at B. BD is an altitude. AD = 3 cm and DC = 9 cm. What is the value of AB (in cm)?
questions.questionHtml: ΔABC is right angled at B. BD is an altitude. AD = 3 cm and DC = 9 cm. What is the value of AB (in cm)?

Writing cos of ∠BAC in triangle ABC and in triangle ABD

⇒ cos (∠BAC) = AD/AB = AB/AC

⇒ 3/AB = AB/12

⇒ AB2 = 36

⇒ AB = 6 cm

questions.question: A bag has Rs. 51.25 in the form of 2 - rupee, 50 - paise and 25 - paise coins in the ratio of 3 : 5 : 7. What is the total number of 50 - paise coins?
questions.questionHtml: A bag has Rs. 51.25 in the form of 2 - rupee, 50 - paise and 25 - paise coins in the ratio of 3 : 5 : 7. What is the total number of 50 - paise coins?
questions.solution:
Let the number of 2 - rupee, 50 - paise and 25 - paise coins be a, b and c

According to the problem statement

⇒ 2a + b/2 + c/4 = 51.25

Given that they are in ratio 3 : 5 : 7, so 2 - rupee, 50 - paise and 25 - paise are 3x, 5x and 7x respectively, put this in the above equation

⇒ 2 × 3x + 5x/2 + 7x/4 = 51.25, Multiply both sides by 4

⇒ 24x + 10x + 7x = 205

⇒ 41x = 205

⇒ x = 5

⇒ 50 - paise coins are 5x = 5 × 5 = 25

∴ There were 25 coins of 50 - paise

questions.question: What is the value of Cot 60 - Sec 45?
questions.questionHtml: What is the value of Cot 60 - Sec 45?
questions.solution:
Since we know that cot 60 = 1/√3 and sec 45 = √2, put this in the required equation

⇒ Cot 60 - Sec 45 = 1/√3 - √2 = √3/3 - 3√2/3 = (√3 - 3√2)/3

∴ The value of Cot 60 - Sec 45 is (√3 - 3√2)/3

questions.question: If Cot θ = 24/7, then Sin θ = ?
questions.questionHtml: If Cot θ = 24/7, then Sin θ = ?
questions.solution:
Given cot θ = 24/7

Cosec θ can be given as

⇒ Cosec θ = √(cot2 θ + 1) = √( 242/72 + 1) = √{(576 + 49)/72} = √(252/72) = 25/7

⇒ Sin θ = 1/Cosec θ = 7/25

∴ sin θ is 7/25

questions.question: The cost price of an article is x. It is marked up by 150%. It is sold at Rs. 600 after giving 40% discount. What is x (in Rs.)?
questions.questionHtml: The cost price of an article is x. It is marked up by 150%. It is sold at Rs. 600 after giving 40% discount. What is x (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
Cost price after marking it up by 150%

Cost price after marking up = x × (1 + 150/100) = 2.5x

After 40% discount

⇒ 2.5x(1 - 40/100) = 600

⇒ 2.5x = 600/0.6 = 1000

⇒ x = 400

∴ x is Rs. 400

questions.question: The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph. questions.questionHtml:
The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

This idea, however startling it may at

X-first appear, is quite in accordance, as 

Y-before stated, with the analogy of changes

Z-now going on in certain regions of the globe
questions.solution:
The first sentence segment makes it clear that the second sentence should be X since 'it may at first appear' makes perfect sense in the context of the sentence. The second sentence should be Y because putting Z after X makes the sentence without any meaning.

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in meaning to the word given. Incentive
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in meaning to the word given.

Incentive
questions.solution:
The word 'incentive' means 
a thing that motivates or encourages someone to do something. The word 'hindrance' means a thing that provides resistance, delay, or obstruction to something or someone.
 
The other words mean:

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word similar in meaning to the word given. Belligerent
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word similar in meaning to the word given.

Belligerent
questions.solution:
The word that is similar in meaning to belligerent is Antagonistic.

Key Points

  • Belligerent means hostile and aggressive. (शत्रुतापूर्ण और आक्रामक.)
  • Antagonistic also means hostile and unfriendly. (शत्रुतापूर्ण और अमित्र।)

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

The other options are not similar in meaning to belligerent.

  • Co-operative means willing to work together. (साथ मिलकर काम करने को इच्छुक.)
  • Dandy means stylish and fashionable. (स्टाइलिश और फैशनेबल.)
  • Delightful means causing delight or pleasure. (प्रसन्नता या आनंद उत्पन्न करना।)

questions.question: The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph. There was no need to X-set a watch, for we had nothing Y-to fear from anybody or Z-anything in that vast untenanted plain
questions.questionHtml:
The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

There was no need to

X-set a watch, for we had nothing 

Y-to fear from anybody or 

Z-anything in that vast untenanted plain
questions.solution:
The first sentence ends with 'to' which makes it evident that Y cannot be a possible option. Since Z makes the sentence grammatically incorrect, the second sentence should be X. As is evident from the sentence 'nothing to fear' makes sense in the current context and therefore the third sentence should be Y.

And by extension, the last sentence should be Z.

questions.question: Sub Sharan Africa has lost how many black rhino genetic lineages in 200 years?
questions.questionHtml: Sub Sharan Africa has lost how many black rhino genetic lineages in 200 years?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 44

Key Points

  • From the line given in the passage: Two centuries ago, the black rhinoceros – which roamed much of sub-Saharan Africa – had 64 different genetic lineages; but today only 20 of these lineages remain, says the paper. 
  • Thus, from this line, it can be inferred that Sub Sharan Africa has (64-20) i.e. 44 black rhino genetic lineages in 200 years.\

Additional Information

  • Lineages: direct descent from an ancestor; ancestry or pedigree

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in meaning to the word given. Benediction
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in meaning to the word given.

Benediction
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Criticism.

Key Points

  • The word "Benediction" means a blessing or an expression of good wishes. (आशीर्वाद)
    • Example: The priest gave a benediction at the end of the service.
  • "Criticism" refers to the expression of disapproval of someone or something based on perceived faults or mistakes. (आलोचना)
    • Example: The book received a lot of criticism for its controversial themes.
  • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'benediction' is 'criticism'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Innovation (नवाचार): The act or process of introducing new ideas, devices, or methods.
    • Example: The company's success is due to its continuous innovation.
  • Beautitude (परमानंद): Supreme blessedness or happiness.
    • Example: Her face shone with beautitude as she held her newborn baby.

In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the words/sentence.

An arrangement of flowers fastened in a ring used for laying on a grave
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Wreath.

Key Points

  • The word "Wreath" refers to an arrangement of flowers, leaves, or stems fastened in a ring and used for decoration or for laying on a grave. (माला)
    • Example: The family placed a beautiful wreath on the grave to honour their loved one.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Brier (झाड़ी): A wild rose or any prickly bush.
    • Example: The garden was full of briers that needed to be trimmed.
  • Prickle (कांटा): A small, sharp-pointed growth on the bark or stem of a plant.
    • Example: The prickle on the rose stem made it difficult to handle.
  • Splint (पट्टी): A strip of rigid material used for supporting and immobilizing a broken bone when it has been set.
    • Example: The doctor used a splint to immobilize the patient's fractured arm.
